name: Token Debug UI
description: Provides a simple admin form to test token replacement against real entities and inspect the resolved values and cacheability metadata.

suggests.token: Required in practice for the token browser link (token_tree_link theme) rendered on the form; not declared in tokendebug.info.yml.

project_description:
Provides a form to debug tokens:

 
 Fill in some entity types/IDs like node:17 
 Browse tokens (needs token module) 
 Fill in some text with tokens, like This is node "[node:title]" by "[node:author:name]". 
 Click Submit 
 => See the text with tokens replaced, like This is node "Test page" by "admin". 
 Optionally, get a dump of token cacheability (cache tags, contexts, and max-age)
